lines.beaver_en: What exercise do you do these days?
lines.learner: 저는 수영을 해요. 수영장에 자주 가요.
lines.en: I swim. I often go to the swimming pool.
lines.roman: jeoneun suyeongeul haeyo. suyeongjange jaju gayo.

lines.learner: 아니요, 가까워요. 아침에 시간이 있을 때 가요.
lines.en: No, it's close. I go when I have time in the morning.
lines.roman: aniyo, gakkawoyo. achime sigani isseul ttae gayo.

lines.beaver_en: I go running at the field.
lines.learner: 저도 달리기를 좋아해요. 날씨가 좋을 때 뛰어요.
lines.en: I like running too. I run when the weather is nice.
lines.roman: jeodo dalligireul joahaeyo. nalssiga joeul ttae ttwieoyo.

lines.beaver_en: What do you do when it rains?
lines.en: When it rains, I work out at the gym.

lines.beaver_en: When do you go to the gym?
lines.en: Usually in the evening, after class ends.

lines.beaver_en: Isn't it hard when you exercise?
lines.learner: 뛸 때 약간 힘들어요. 그래도 재미있어요.
lines.en: It's a little hard when I run. But it's fun.
lines.roman: ttwil ttae yakgan himdeureoyo. geuraedo jaemiisseoyo.

lines.en: Sure! Let's run together at the field on Saturday.

lines.beaver_en: What time is good on Saturday?
lines.learner: 아침에 시원할 때 뛰어요. 아홉 시 어때요?
lines.en: Let's run in the morning when it's cool. How about nine?
lines.roman: achime siwonhal ttae ttwieoyo. ahop si eottaeyo?

lines.beaver_en: Good. Shall we swim after running too?
lines.learner: 네, 좋아요! 운동장 옆에 수영장이 있어요.
lines.en: Yes, great! There's a pool next to the field.
lines.roman: ne, joayo! undongjang yeope suyeongjangi isseoyo.

lines.beaver: 그럼 토요일 아홉 시에 운동장에서 만나요!
lines.beaver_en: Then let's meet at the field at nine on Saturday!
lines.beaver_roman: geureom toyoil ahop sie undongjangeseo mannayo!
lines.learner: 네, 토요일에 만나요. 운동할 때 물 가져와요!
lines.en: Okay, see you Saturday. Bring water for when we work out!
lines.roman: ne, toyoire mannayo. undonghal ttae mul gajyeowayo!
